Homemade Frozen Pops
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 20, 2009 - 12:32am

Ingredients




1 Kool Aid, unsweetened, pack.
1 Jelly Powder, package
3/4 cup Granulated Sugar
2 cups Boiling Water
2 cups Cold Water

Preparation

1 Servings: 18 2 In a 2-quart glass measure, combine the Kool Aid, jelly powder and sugar. 3 Add hot water and stir until sugar is dissolved. Stir in cold water. Pour into pop molds and freeze. 4 Makes about 18.
